name: What is the typical lifespan of soft close drawer mechanisms?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of soft close drawer mechanisms?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of soft close drawer mechanisms can vary significantly based on the quality of the slides and frequency of use. High-quality soft close slides from reputable manufacturers are often tested to withstand tens of thousands of cycles, typically lasting 15-20 years or more under normal household use. Cheaper alternatives may have a shorter lifespan. Regular and proper use, avoiding excessive force, also contributes to their longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-quality soft close mechanisms can last 15-20 years or more, depending on use and manufacturer.
